name: Median earnings
definition: Median annual earnings of full-time, year-round workers age 16 and over.

name: Labor force participation
definition: Share of people age 20 to 64 who are working or actively looking for work.

name: Poverty rate
definition: Share of people whose family income in the past 12 months was below the federal poverty threshold.

name: Bachelor's degree rate
definition: Share of adults age 25 and over who hold a bachelor's degree or higher.

name: College enrollment
definition: Share of people age 18 to 24 enrolled in college or graduate school.

name: STEM degrees
definition: Share of bachelor's degree holders age 25 and over whose first major was in a science or engineering field.

name: Suicide mortality
definition: Age-adjusted deaths by suicide per 100,000 residents of the same sex.

name: Homicide mortality
definition: Age-adjusted deaths by homicide per 100,000 residents of the same sex.

name: State legislative seats
definition: Share of seats in the state legislature (both chambers combined).

name: Incarceration rate
definition: Sentenced prisoners under state or federal jurisdiction per 100,000 residents of the same sex.
